name: Lazy Lake R.V. Park
description: Lazy Lake R.V. Park is located in Gulf Shores, Alabama, 5 miles from the beautiful beaches. The park offers clean and well-maintained facilities with full hookups, cable TV, stocked lake for fishing, all spaces with lake view, bath house, laundry facilities, WiFi on site, and on-site manager. We pride ourselves on offering the best value for RV campers looking to enjoy the Gulf Coast.
